none: PAS NLM-1C35B1: Roman Coin: copy Radiate of Victorinus
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate, possibly a copy or irregular issue, probably of Victorinus (269-271), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [---]NVS AVG. Reverse description: Female figure with spear and shield standing right, possibly Minerva. Reverse inscription: Letters present but possibly blundered. Diameter: 15.6mm, Weight: 1.17gms
